axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. Creature faces glTF +Z (Blender -Y), ground contact at y = 0; the engine turns it with yaw(angle) * rot_y(PI).

rig.core: GF_Hero_v1 core names and parents (23 bones, docs/ART_PIPELINE.md section 5); the legs are hidden under the robe and swing its front panels
rig.skinning: rigid: every part on one bone (slag robe tiers, arms, the floating crucible and runes)
rig.rest_pose: the idle stance (the crucible held over the cowl)
rig.axes: bone +Y along the bone, +Z toward the front (Ashen Covenant roll convention)
rig.crown_spin: the rune ring turns about crown_spin's local +Y; the clips bake the spin (a multiple of 120 deg per clip: the glyphs repeat every two runes). The client may add spin on top.

clip_roles.molten_hexer_idle@loop: hovering stance: the crucible bobs over the cowl, the rune ring turns slowly (120 deg a loop), the melt breathes
clip_roles.molten_hexer_move@loop: glide: leaning in, the front robe panels step, the crucible trails and the ring tilts back
clip_roles.molten_hexer_windup: the channel begins: it rears back and hoists the crucible, the ring pulls in tight and whirls (ends loaded)
clip_roles.molten_hexer_attack: the beam: the crucible is thrust forward and tipped, the ring swings upright in front of the lip (the beam passes through it), a hold, then back to the stance
clip_roles.molten_hexer_hit: flinch: the crucible jolts, the runes are flung outward
clip_roles.molten_hexer_death: the tower sags and sinks into itself, the crucible slips and spills on its side, the runes drop into the spreading pool (held)
clip_roles.molten_hexer_channel@loop: the long channel pose: loaded and trembling, the ring whirling (240 deg a loop), the melt surging (play after windup while the sim holds the windup)
clip_roles.molten_hexer_beam_sweep@loop: the beam held and dragged across the arena: the fire pose with the torso and the focus yawing +-28 deg, the ring spinning fast

caster_mapping: Caster windup (the sim holds still under the line telegraph) -> windup (0.6 s), then channel@loop until the beam lands -> attack (the fire key at 0.23 s). A held or sweeping beam -> beam_sweep@loop. Beam VFX from attack_origin (the focus ring), spill and drip VFX at fx_mouth, the glow and the death burst at fx_core.
